description: Get Bitcoin holder supply breakdown: Long-Term Holder (LTH) supply, Short-Term Holder (STH) supply, and circulating supply. LTH = held >155 days, STH = held <155 days. Values in BTC.

days.description: Number of daily data points to return

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides days param when set.
